data.title: 神罚 · 暖阳客厅的静谧膝枕
data.description: 午后客厅暖阳倾泻，神罚坐在松软的布艺沙发上。她温柔地引导你枕在自己的大腿上，低头专注凝视着你，纤细的指尖轻抚你的头发，哼唱着温柔的歌谣。
data.location: cozy living room couch beside sunny window
data.action: sitting on sofa, offering lap pillow, gently stroking hair, hummed lullaby, gazing downward with pure adoration
data.lighting: warm golden afternoon sunshine through window
data.promptProse: Sitting on a comfy couch in afternoon sunlight, Modernia gives a gentle lap pillow, stroking hair while looking down with devoted adoration.
data.animaCaption: Modernia giving a soothing lap pillow on a sunlit sofa.
